summary: IDS feed s095_single is degraded due to 22.4% duplicate packets (790/3520) well above 5% threshold; all other checks (one-way, drops, overload, VLAN, encryption) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is aggregating overlapping SPAN/TAP sources or forwarding the same packet via multiple paths without deduplication, causing the same packets to be delivered twice to the IDS port.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS wastes CPU/memory reprocessing duplicates, inflates flow/packet counters, breaks TCP stream reassembly and can cause missed detections or false positives under load.

recommended_fix.why: Hardware deduplication at the packet broker will drop duplicate packets within a short time window before delivery, restoring accurate traffic volume for IDS detection without losing unique packets.
